title: 14 MeV Point Neutron Source in Water Sphere
description: Fixed-source 14.1 MeV D-T fusion point neutron source at the center of a 30 cm light-water moderation sphere with F4 cell-averaged flux tally.
code:
14.1 MeV Point Neutron Source in 30 cm Light-Water Sphere
C Block 1: Cell Cards
1 1 -1.00 -1 IMP:N=1 VOL=113097.3 $ Light water moderator sphere
2 0        1 IMP:N=0              $ External void graveyard

C Block 2: Surface Cards
1 SO 30.0 $ Outer water sphere radius (cm)

C Block 3: Data Cards
MODE N
M1 1001.80c 2.0 8016.80c 1.0
MT1 lwtr.01t
SDEF POS=0 0 0 ERG=14.1 PAR=N
F4:N 1
E4 1.0e-7 1.0e-4 0.1 1.0 14.2
NPS 10000

title: Lead and Polyethylene Layered Gamma-Neutron Shield
description: Coupled neutron-photon transport through a two-layer borated polyethylene and lead biological slab shield with surface flux tallies.
code:
Lead and Borated Polyethylene Layered Gamma-Neutron Shield
C Block 1: Cell Cards
1 0        -1 2 -3 4 -5 6 IMP:N=1 IMP:P=1 $ Source air cavity
2 1 -0.95  -7 1 -3 4 -5 6 IMP:N=1 IMP:P=1 $ 20 cm Polyethylene neutron shield
3 2 -11.35 -8 7 -3 4 -5 6 IMP:N=1 IMP:P=1 $ 10 cm Lead gamma shield
4 0         8:-2:3:-4:5:-6 IMP:N=0 IMP:P=0 $ External graveyard

C Block 2: Surface Cards
1 PX 10.0  $ Front of polyethylene slab
2 PX 0.0   $ Source cavity back plane
3 PY 50.0  $ Top Y boundary
4 PY -50.0 $ Bottom Y boundary
5 PZ 50.0  $ Top Z boundary
6 PZ -50.0 $ Bottom Z boundary
7 PX 30.0  $ Polyethylene-Lead interface
8 PX 40.0  $ Outer shield exit face

C Block 3: Data Cards
MODE N P
M1 6000.80c 1.0 1001.80c 2.0
M2 82206.80c 0.241 82207.80c 0.221 82208.80c 0.524
SDEF POS=2.0 0.0 0.0 VEC=1 0 0 DIR=1 ERG=2.5 PAR=N
F2:N 8
F2:P 8
NPS 20000

title: Godiva Bare HEU Sphere Criticality Benchmark
description: ICSBEP HEU-MET-FAST-001 Godiva bare highly enriched uranium metal sphere KCODE eigenvalue criticality benchmark with fast energy spectrum tally.
code:
Godiva Bare Highly Enriched Uranium Sphere (HEU-MET-FAST-001)
C Block 1: Cell Cards
1 1 -18.74 -1 IMP:N=1 VOL=2797.5 $ HEU metal sphere (93.71 wt% U-235)
2 0         1 IMP:N=0            $ External vacuum graveyard

C Block 2: Surface Cards
1 SO 8.7407 $ Critical bare sphere radius (cm)

C Block 3: Data Cards
MODE N
M1 92234.80c 0.0102 &
   92235.80c 0.9371 &
   92238.80c 0.0527
KCODE 5000 1.0 20 120
KSRC 0.0 0.0 0.0
F4:N 1
E4 0.01 0.1 0.5 1.0 2.0 5.0 10.0 20.0
PHYS:N 20.0 0.0

title: PWR UO2 Fuel Pin Cell Criticality Benchmark
description: Infinite-lattice 17x17 PWR 4.2% enriched UO2 fuel pin cell with helium gap, Zircaloy-4 cladding, light-water moderator, and reflective boundaries.
code:
PWR 17x17 UO2 Fuel Pin Cell Infinite Lattice Criticality
C Block 1: Cell Cards
1 1 -10.29 -1 4 -5       IMP:N=1 $ UO2 fuel pellet (r = 0.4096 cm)
2 0         1 -2 4 -5    IMP:N=1 $ Helium fuel-clad gap (r = 0.4180 cm)
3 2 -6.55   2 -3 4 -5    IMP:N=1 $ Zircaloy-4 cladding (r = 0.4750 cm)
4 3 -0.71   3 -6 7 -8 9 4 -5 IMP:N=1 $ Pressurized light-water moderator
5 0         6:-7:8:-9:-4:5   IMP:N=0 $ External graveyard

C Block 2: Surface Cards
1 CZ 0.4096  $ Fuel pellet outer radius
2 CZ 0.4180  $ Cladding inner radius
3 CZ 0.4750  $ Cladding outer radius
*4 PZ -182.88 $ Active fuel bottom reflective plane
*5 PZ  182.88 $ Active fuel top reflective plane
*6 PX  0.6300 $ Pin pitch +X reflective boundary
*7 PX -0.6300 $ Pin pitch -X reflective boundary
*8 PY  0.6300 $ Pin pitch +Y reflective boundary
*9 PY -0.6300 $ Pin pitch -Y reflective boundary

C Block 3: Data Cards
MODE N
M1 92235.80c 0.042 &
   92238.80c 0.958 &
   8016.80c  2.000
M2 40090.80c 0.507 &
   40091.80c 0.111 &
   40092.80c 0.170 &
   40094.80c 0.172 &
   50120.80c 0.015 &
   26056.80c 0.025
M3 1001.80c 2.0 8016.80c 1.0
MT3 lwtr.01t
KCODE 4000 1.25 25 125
KSRC 0.0 0.0 0.0
F4:N 1 4
E4 0.625e-6 0.1 1.0 20.0

title: Tokamak Blanket Tritium-Breeding and Shielding Sector
description: 14.1 MeV D-T fusion neutronics model of a tungsten first-wall, LiPb tritium-breeding blanket, and stainless-steel vacuum vessel with companion material library.
code:
Tokamak First-Wall, LiPb Tritium-Breeding Blanket and Vacuum Vessel Sector
C Companion isotopic specifications archived in materials.inc
C Block 1: Cell Cards
1 0        -1 6 -7    IMP:N=1 IMP:P=1 $ D-T plasma chamber
2 1 -19.25  1 -2 6 -7 IMP:N=1 IMP:P=1 $ 2 cm Tungsten armor first wall
3 2 -9.40   2 -3 6 -7 IMP:N=1 IMP:P=1 $ 48 cm Li-17Pb-83 breeding blanket
4 3 -7.90   3 -4 6 -7 IMP:N=1 IMP:P=1 $ 30 cm SS316LN vacuum vessel shield
5 4 -8.96   4 -5 6 -7 IMP:N=1 IMP:P=1 $ 20 cm TF magnet winding pack
6 0         5:-6:7    IMP:N=0 IMP:P=0 $ External graveyard

C Block 2: Surface Cards
1 CZ 200.0  $ First-wall plasma-facing radius (cm)
2 CZ 202.0  $ Back of tungsten armor
3 CZ 250.0  $ Back of LiPb breeding blanket
4 CZ 280.0  $ Back of SS316LN vacuum vessel
5 CZ 300.0  $ Outer boundary of TF coil casing
*6 PZ -150.0 $ Lower poloidal symmetry plane
*7 PZ  150.0 $ Upper poloidal symmetry plane

C Block 3: Data Cards
MODE N P
M1 74182.80c 0.265 74183.80c 0.143 74184.80c 0.306 74186.80c 0.284
M2 3006.80c 0.153 3007.80c 0.017 82206.80c 0.200 82207.80c 0.183 82208.80c 0.447
M3 26056.80c 0.680 24052.80c 0.170 28058.80c 0.120 42096.80c 0.030
M4 29063.80c 0.692 29065.80c 0.308
SDEF POS=0 0 0 ERG=14.1 PAR=N
F4:N 2 3 4 5
F6:N 2 3 5
F6:P 2 3 5
E4 1.0e-6 0.1 1.0 10.0 14.5
NPS 50000
